translation: We sent it down on the Night of Decree
But what will convey to you what the Night of Decree is

arabic: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months

arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
translation: In it descend the angels and the Spirit, by the leave of their Lord, with every command
Peace it is; until the rise of dawn
